# Search — `redmine_search`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_read-only_

Free-text search across issues, wiki pages, news, and projects in one call. Best first move for vague requests where the issue id or project is unknown; prefer redmine_list_issues when you already have concrete filter values.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `q` | string | **yes** | Free-text query, e.g. "login button bug" (required). |
| `scope` | `all` \| `my_project` \| `subprojects` | no | Search scope: "all", "my_project", or "subprojects". |
| `issues` | boolean | no | Include issues in the results. |
| `news` | boolean | no | Include news in the results. |
| `wiki_pages` | boolean | no | Include wiki pages in the results. |
| `projects` | boolean | no | Include projects in the results. |
| `open_issues` | boolean | no | Restrict issue matches to open issues only. |
| `all_words` | boolean | no | Require all query words to match (AND vs OR). |
| `titles_only` | boolean | no | Match only titles, not body text. |
| `offset` | integer | no | Pagination offset (skip N results). |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results to return. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_search",
  "arguments": {
    "q": "login button bug",
    "scope": "all"
  }
}
```
